# Fedimint Observer

> Public monitoring of Fedimint federations, guardians, wallets and Lightning gateways.

## Pages

- [Federations](/): Observed federations, aggregate assets and recent activity.
- [Nostr announcements](/nostr): Federation discovery through public Nostr announcements.
- [Source code](https://github.com/fedimint/fedimint-observer): Implementation and development documentation.

## Public data

- [Federation summaries](/api/federations): Observed federation identifiers, health and recent activity.
- [Aggregate statistics](/api/federations/totals): Federation count, transactions and public volume.

Federation pages use /federations/{id}. Lightning v2 gateway pages use
/federations/{id}/gateways/v2. Discover identifiers from the federation summaries.
API snapshots can be stale or incomplete. An online gateway observation does not
guarantee Lightning liquidity or successful payment routing. This website does
not advertise an autonomous agent or MCP service.
